policy.direction_target: currency strength first; pair score equals base currency score minus quote currency score
policy.causal_view: pre_entry_causal links only; effective_from must not exceed episode entry
policy.story_deduplication: one highest-quality observation per story cluster and episode
policy.response_calibration: chronological discovery split learns follow/fade/abstain by event type and horizon; later split is diagnostic holdout
policy.movement_selection_warning: large-move-conditioned episodes measure attribution quality, not unconditional trade expectancy
policy.promotion: never; a frozen all-timestamp prospective cohort is required
